## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (and `npm run smoke` for gameplay or UI changes)
- [ ] Replays and tuning unchanged, or the change is intended and `CLIENT_VERSION` was bumped
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the diff
- [ ] Docs updated (README, CLAUDE.md, `docs/`) when behaviour, paths or deploy steps changed
